scientific_anchor.published_process: anadromous trout leave already colonized rivers and disperse through the marine environment to reproduce in new hydrographic systems; no local extinction was documented thereafter after successful reproduction
scientific_anchor.node_frame_note: the paper analyzes 85 contiguous river systems; the monitoring zone expanded historically following introduction attempts. frozen_matrix_parser.page_rule: run pdftotext -layout under the frozen runtime, require the exact frozen layout-text SHA, split on form-feed, discard only empty trailing page fragments, and require exactly three nonempty page texts in published scenario order
frozen_matrix_parser.row_candidate_rule: within each page, retain exactly those nonempty lines containing at least 85 tokens matching [+-]?[0-9]+(?:[.,][0-9]+)?; require exactly 85 retained lines per page
frozen_matrix_parser.rightmost_85_rule: for each retained row, the rightmost 85 numeric-regex matches are the distance vector. All preceding characters, stripped only at the outer edges, are the exact river label. This deliberately protects labels containing digits such as Brook 1 Ile du Port and Gorfous 1 from being misparsed as distances
frozen_matrix_parser.numeric_rule: replace a single decimal comma with decimal point before float conversion; values must be finite and non-negative
frozen_matrix_parser.label_rule: require 85 unique nonempty exact labels per page and require the same ordered label tuple on all three pages; no case folding, fuzzy alias repair, translation or node deletion is allowed
frozen_matrix_parser.matrix_rule: require exactly 85x85 values per scenario, zero diagonal within 1e-9 and symmetry within atol=rtol=1e-9

structural_universe_rule.justification: EOG world-universe scale design evaluates adequacy of the declared universe as a whole when multiple legitimate primary metric/process alternatives exist; fragmented or scale-collapsed hypotheses are retained rather than deleted
structural_universe_rule.build_rule: build the standard response-blind structural ladder separately on each of the three frozen distance matrices; retain every scenario x ladder level even when thresholds repeat within a scenario
structural_universe_rule.adjacency_distinctness_rule: distinctness is based on exact binary adjacency fingerprints, not comparison of threshold magnitudes across distance hypotheses
structural_universe_rule.stop_rule: if the complete declared universe fails these pre-response criteria, close the candidate before Appendix S1 access
